name: Readwise
description: Readwise lets agents search the highlights of the signed-in user and read the documents saved in Readwise Reader. Each user signs in to their own Readwise account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find my highlights about habit formation.
What did I save to Reader this week that I have not read yet?
Summarize the highlights from the last book I finished.

apps.name: Readwise
apps.description: Highlights and Reader documents, over Readwise's MCP server with browser sign-in.
